summary.text: David Thomas is a Republican state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 65 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. He is vice chair of the House Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Thomas was born in Ohio and earned a bachelor’s degree from Washington and Lee University in 2015 and a graduate degree from Baldwin Wallace University in 2018.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was the Ashtabula County Auditor, and he named property tax reform, customer service and accessibility, and being pro-life and pro-gun as his key messages.
Thomas won the 2024 Republican primary for District 65 over Laurie Magyar.
In the 2025–2026 session he was assigned to the Arts, Athletics, and Tourism; Energy; Public Insurance and Pensions; and Ways and Means (vice chair) committees.
